note: Frozen prompt set for measuring generation quality. Covers the types recognized by classifyGeneratedAppType plus deliberate out-of-category prompts that must fall into generic_web_app and still produce a rich product.

prompts.prompt: Create a conversion-focused landing page for an AI code assistant: hero, social proof, feature proof, pricing, and a clear primary CTA.
Build a SaaS team workspace dashboard with project list, search, usage area, recent activity and an empty state.
Create an analytics dashboard with KPI metric tiles, a date range filter, charts and a sortable comparison table.
Build an admin back office to manage users with a sidebar, search, a data table, row actions and a delete confirmation.
Create a marketplace to discover and book local service providers with search, filters, listing cards, seller trust badges and a no-results state.
Build an ecommerce shop with a product catalog, filters, product cards, a cart drawer, quantity changes and a checkout summary.
Create a restaurant app with a menu by category, a reservation form, opening hours, location and reviews.
Build an editorial portfolio for a product designer with selected work, case studies, an about section and a contact CTA.
Create a CRM with a sales pipeline, lead records, filters, a record detail panel, a form with validation and an activity log.
Build a mobile-first habit tracker PWA with bottom navigation, a sticky primary action, swipeable cards and per-screen states.
Create an auth flow with login and signup, show/hide password, validation, a forgot-password path and a privacy note.
Build an AI writing assistant with a prompt input, streamed responses, conversation history, cancel/retry and a settings panel.
Create a fintech billing app with a balance summary, a transactions table, invoices, a payment method and clear risk states.
Build a patient education portal with course progress, resources, a calm readable layout, consent notes and accessible forms.
Create a browser memory card game with an interactive board, score, reset, win state and immediate feedback.
Build a todo app with add, edit, delete, complete toggle, a filter (all/active/done), search and responsive layout.
Create a social feed with post cards, like and comment actions, a compose box, optimistic updates and an empty feed state.
Build an e-learning course player with lessons, progress indicators, a quiz with per-answer feedback and a completion state.
Create a chat messenger with a conversation list, an active thread, message input with Enter-to-send, unread badges and timestamps.
Build a CSV explorer that imports a file, shows a sortable filterable table, handles malformed input and exports to JSON.
Create a drawing whiteboard with a canvas, color and brush controls, undo/redo, reset and PNG export.
Build a job board directory with searchable filterable listings, listing cards with metadata, an apply action and a no-results state.
Build a small tool to plan my weekly meal prep and generate a grocery list from the chosen recipes.
Create an app that helps a beekeeper log hive inspections and spot trends across the season.
Make a tool for a tabletop RPG group to track initiative order and character conditions during combat.
Build something to help a freelance translator quote jobs by word count, language pair and deadline.
Create an app for a community garden to assign plots, schedule watering shifts and post notices.
Make a tool to compare two job offers across salary, benefits, commute and growth, with a clear recommendation.
